description: Solve equations exactly with worked steps, like the website: linear a·x + b = c, quadratic a·x² + b·x + c = 0 (exact rational or surd roots like 1/2 + √5/2, complex roots), cubic a·x³ + b·x² + c·x + d = 0 (rational root test, else trigonometric/Cardano to 10 significant digits), and systems of 2 or 3 linear equations (Gauss–Jordan; no solution and infinitely many solutions are detected and parametrised). Coefficients may be integers, decimals, fractions ("3/4"), mixed numbers ("-1 1/2") or e-notation. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/equation-solver/

coefficients.description: linear: [a, b, c] for a·x + b = c; quadratic: [a, b, c]; cubic: [a, b, c, d].

system.description: system: rows of the augmented matrix, 2 rows of [a, b, rhs] (x, y) or 3 rows of [a, b, c, rhs] (x, y, z).

name: calc_equation
title: Equation solver
